info.title: OMA LwM2M Thread Neighbor Information (Object ID 10485)

Thread_Neighbor_Information.label: Thread Neighbor Information
Thread_Neighbor_Information.description: This LwM2M Object provides diagnostic information about Thread neighbors

Neighbor_Role.label: Neighbor Role
Neighbor_Role.description:
Provides the type of neighbor as Enumerated type:
				0: Child
				1: Router

RLOC16_Address.label: RLOC16 Address
RLOC16_Address.description: The Routing Locator (RLOC16) identifies a Thread interface, based on its location in the network topology.

Age.label: Age
Age.description: The age is a measure of how long it has been since the last communication or interaction with that particular network neighbor.

Average_RSSI.label: Average RSSI
Average_RSSI.description: The average Received Signal Strength Indication (RSSI) over a specific period.

Last_RSSI.label: Last RSSI
Last_RSSI.description: The instantaneous Received Signal Strength Indication (RSSI).

Rx_On_When_Idle.label: Rx On When Idle
Rx_On_When_Idle.description: Neighbor mode R represents "RX on when idle".

Full_Thread_Device.label: Full Thread Device
Full_Thread_Device.description: Neighbor mode D represents "Full Thread device".

Full_Network_Data.label: Full Network Data
Full_Network_Data.description: Neighbor mode N represents "Full network data".

Link_Quality_In.label: Link Quality In
Link_Quality_In.description:
Neighbor Link quality In. Link Quality is an integer in [0, 3]. A higher link quality indicates a more usable link, with 0 indicating that the
link is non-existent or unusable.

Link_Quality_Out.label: Link Quality Out
Link_Quality_Out.description:
Neighbor Link quality Out. Link Quality is an integer in [0, 3]. A higher link quality indicates a more usable link, with 0 indicating that the
link is non-existent or unusable.

Queued_Message_Count.label: Queued Message Count
Queued_Message_Count.description: Queued Message count. A non-zero Queued Message Count indicates that there are messages waiting to be delivered, and it can be useful for assessing the network's communication efficiency and load.
